properties.DailyDataQuery:
SELECT ma.Client AS "ClientBillingNo"
	  ,ma.CLIENT_DESCRIPTION AS "ClientName"
	  ,ma.Status_code AS "ClientStatusId"
	  ,ma.MATTER AS "MatterBillingNo"
	  ,ma.Short_Description AS "MatterName"
	  ,ma.MATTER_STATUS_CODE AS "MatterStatus"
	  ,ma.Opened_date AS "OpenedOn"
	  ,ma.CLosed_date AS "ClosedOn"
	  ,ma.MATTER_TYPE_DESCRIPTION AS "Practice"
	  ,att.Email_address AS "ResponsibleAttorney"
	  ,'0' AS Private
FROM KWEXPORT.Matter ma
JOIN KWEXPORT.Client cl ON cl.client = ma.client
JOIN KWEXPORT.Attorney att ON att.attorney = ma.Responsible_attorney
where  (cl.LAST_CHANGE_DATE >='${now():toNumber():minus(3600000):format('yyyy-MM-dd')}' or ma.LAST_CHANGE_DATE >='${now():toNumber():minus(3600000):format('yyyy-MM-dd')}')
properties.FullDataQuery:
SELECT ma.Client AS "ClientBillingNo"
	  ,ma.CLIENT_DESCRIPTION AS "ClientName"
	  ,ma.Status_code AS "ClientStatusId"
	  ,ma.MATTER AS "MatterBillingNo"
	  ,ma.Short_Description AS "MatterName"
	  ,ma.MATTER_STATUS_CODE AS "MatterStatus"
	  ,ma.Opened_date AS "OpenedOn"
	  ,ma.CLosed_date AS "ClosedOn"
	  ,ma.MATTER_TYPE_DESCRIPTION AS "Practice"
	  ,att.Email_address AS "ResponsibleAttorney"
	  ,'0' AS Private
FROM KWEXPORT.Matter ma
JOIN KWEXPORT.Client cl ON cl.client = ma.client
JOIN KWEXPORT.Attorney att ON att.attorney = ma.Responsible_attorney
